name: Bookkeeping
description: The default bookkeeper starter pack: daily entries, weekly reports, payroll and government remittances, monthly reconciliations and financial statements, quarterly tax returns and yearly filings.

definitions.title: Record cash receipts and payments
definitions.note: Record all incoming cash collections and outgoing cash payments in the accounting system on the same day, against receipts.

definitions.title: Process incoming invoices
definitions.note: Review incoming vendor invoices and financial emails, enter them into the accounting system.

definitions.title: Update task statuses
definitions.note: Keep task statuses on the bookkeeping task board up to date.

definitions.title: Weekly pledge report
definitions.note: Prepare the weekly pledge report showing who paid how much and how much remains, and share it with the relevant groups.

definitions.title: Enter work hours
definitions.note: Enter hours worked into the system on a regular basis.

definitions.title: Prepare weekly report
definitions.note: Prepare a short weekly summary of completed entries, pending invoices, reconciliation status and grant statuses.

definitions.title: Review pending invoices and payment list
definitions.note: Check invoices and payments nearing their due dates and give early warnings.

definitions.title: Payroll processing
definitions.note: Calculate and process hours, wages, deductions and net pay. Payroll is done by the person in this role.

definitions.title: Payroll government remittances
definitions.note: Send source deductions (CPP, EI, tax) and employer portions through the bank on time.

definitions.title: Bank account reconciliation
definitions.note: Compare all bank accounts with their statements every month, investigate and correct differences.

definitions.title: Credit card reconciliation
definitions.note: Reconcile all credit cards monthly and file the supporting documents.

definitions.title: Monthly financial statements
definitions.note: Prepare the income-expense report, budget comparison and cash position for the Executive Director.

definitions.title: Department budget report
definitions.note: Prepare and share the per-department planned, actual and remaining budget report.

definitions.title: Monthly grant report
definitions.note: Produce the monthly report showing each grant's total amount, spent and remaining portions.

definitions.title: Monthly regular payments
definitions.note: Make regular payments such as student bursaries, rents and employee funds on time.

definitions.title: GST/HST return
definitions.note: Prepare the GST/HST return and pay it by the deadline.

definitions.title: PST return
definitions.note: Prepare the PST return and pay it on time.

definitions.title: Board financial summary
definitions.note: Compile financial summaries for board meetings.

definitions.title: Budget review
definitions.note: Review department budget actuals and report variances.

definitions.title: Year-end closing
definitions.note: Support year-end closing and coordinate with the external accountant.

definitions.title: T4/T4A summaries
definitions.note: Verify that records are complete for the T4/T4A annual summaries.

definitions.title: T3010 draft data
definitions.note: Prepare the draft data set and supporting reports for the T3010 return.

definitions.title: Audit / review support
definitions.note: Prepare the documents and samples requested for the financial audit / review.

definitions.title: WorkSafeBC annual filing
definitions.note: File the annual WorkSafeBC report and pay the premium.
